themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe continue to capitalize on polling strength and political momentum ahead of key upcoming elections. Parties like Rassemblement National in France and Alternative für Deutschland in Germany are securing major polling leads or campaign funding, while Sweden's SD uses its parliamentary weight to shape coalition and budget talks.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements across several nations face expanding legal investigations, judicial sanctions, and institutional oversight. Conservative leaders and figures routinely frame these actions—ranging from brother detentions in Hungary to impeachment pushes in the US and court arrests in Brazil—as coordinated political sabotage.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing rhetoric surrounding immigration is sharpening across Western Europe, with political leaders demanding immediate remigration, mass deportations, and strict border enforcement. Conservative factions explicitly link immigration rates to domestic housing crises, prison overcrowding, and national identity.
